title: StudyMAF Lesson
description: Source-of-truth schema for a StudyMAF lesson. The code owns this structure; the AI fills in data. Lessons are JSON only, never inline HTML.

figures.description: Optional lesson-level diagrams (same shape as a concept/example figure).

glossary.description: Keyword definitions. Any key that appears in concept/example text is auto-outlined and clickable. Each entry gives a first-time-reader plain explanation AND how the term is used in this class.

concept_sections.description: Ordered simple-to-complex progression. Level 1 is the simplest, grounded starting point; complexity grows as level increases. Every section should carry a figure.

real_world_examples.description: Exactly 3 grounded examples. Each card is collapsible and should carry a deeper 'detail' explanation and a figure.

videos.description: YouTube SEARCH QUERIES, not URLs. Real links are pasted by hand in a later stage. Never fabricate links.

problems.description: Target 20 problems per lesson (spread roughly 6 easy / 8 medium / 4 hard / 2 stretch). A minimum of 8 is accepted so a full multi-lesson course can be authored and expanded over time. None should exceed the class's level.

figure.description: A diagram rendered by the code in a consistent house style; data supplies only parameters. Types: 'schematic' (params.viewBox[w,h] + params.elements[] of primitives: charge {x,y,sign,label,r}, vector/arrow {x1,y1,x2,y2,label,color}, line {x1,y1,x2,y2,color,dash}, circle {x,y,r,dash,label,color}, plate {x,y,w,h,charge}, point {x,y,label,color}, label {x,y,text,color,size}, lens {x,y,h,kind}, ray same as vector); 'coordinate-plane'; 'number-line'.
